about_short_description.short_description: Tizeti provides broadband internet services to densely populated urban centers in Africa.

product.name: Unlimited Wi-Fi Broadband Internet
product.description: High-speed, uncapped broadband internet delivered over wide-area Wi-Fi and fixed wireless networks to residential customers, businesses, estates, offices, multi-tenant buildings, events, and conferences.

product.name: Express Wi-Fi
product.description: A public Wi-Fi hotspot service that provides pay-as-you-go internet access in places such as markets, cafés, and outdoor public spaces.

product.name: WiFiCall
product.description: A voice-calling service and mobile application that enables users to place calls over internet connectivity using voice-over-IP technology.

product.name: Virtual Private Network (VPN) Services
product.description: VPN connectivity delivered alongside Tizeti’s fixed wireless broadband services for residential and small-business users.
